channel.title: Claude Code Live Cheatsheet
channel.description: Auto-updating cheatsheet for Claude Code — keyboard shortcuts, commands, tips, and more.

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.203 highlights
item.description:
• ⏸ footer badge shows active manual permission mode (v2.1.203)
  • MCP roots/list advertises additional working dirs to servers (v2.1.203)
  • ← no longer closes detail views; press Esc instead (v2.1.203)
  • Dynamic workflow size setting: small/medium/large agent counts (v2.1.202)
  • /review <pr> fast single-pass; /code-review for multi-agent review (v2.1.202)
  • Permission mode 'default' renamed to 'Manual' across CLI and IDEs (v2.1.200)
  • Stacked slash-skill invocations load up to 5 leading skills at once (v2.1.199)

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.203
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

+ [mcp-servers] roots/list: Additional working dirs advertised; notifications/roots/list_changed on changes
+ [slash-commands] /status: Show session status and diagnostic warnings
+ [workflows-tips] ⏸ footer badge: Shows active manual permission mode
- [slash-commands] /export

Full changelog

• Added a warning when your login is about to expire, so you can re-authenticate before background sessions are interrupted
• Added a grey ⏸ badge to the footer when in manual permission mode, making the active mode always visible
• Added the session's additional working directories to MCP `roots/list`, with `notifications/roots/list_changed` sent when the set changes
• Fixed opening or switching background agent sessions on macOS stalling for 15–20 seconds due to a false low-memory detection (regression in 2.1.196)
• Fixed background sessions becoming permanently unresponsive to attach, replies, and stop when the daemon's session token went stale — the session now recovers automatically
• Fixed returning to `claude agents` silently stopping running subagents and re-running the prompt from scratch — their work now carries over
• Fixed a memory and per-turn CPU regression in interactive sessions: the context-usage indicator no longer re-analyzes the entire transcript after every turn
• Fixed background agents inheriting a stale `PATH` from the daemon instead of the dispatching shell, causing missing tools on Windows
• Fixed background and agent-view sessions dropping a shell-exported `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`, which sent API keys to the default endpoint and failed with 401
• Fixed Bash failing with "argument list too long" in repos with many git worktrees
• Fixed worktree-isolated subagents sometimes running shell commands in the parent checkout instead of their own worktree
• Fixed worktree creation rejecting nested repositories in multi-repo workspaces, leaving background sessions unable to isolate and edit
• Fixed background agents crash-looping when their working directory was deleted, replaced by a file, or became an invalid path — they now fail once with a clear error
• Fixed a background daemon auto-upgrade failure silently killing all running background sessions
• Fixed `TaskStop` and `TaskOutput` failing to find background agents spawned by another agent — errors now list running agents by id and description
• Fixed the `claude agents` composer discarding your typed message when a slash command isn't available there
• Fixed the agent list crashing when opening a stopped session whose conversation was already open in another session
• Fixed background sessions showing "Needs input" in the agent list after the question was already answered
• Fixed background agent startup failures showing only "exit_with_message" instead of the actual error
• Fixed background sessions ignoring `effortLevel` changes in settings.json when forked through the daemon
• Fixed attached background sessions ignoring `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_MOUSE` and `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_MOUSE_CLICKS` opt-outs
• Fixed `/exit` incorrectly warning about running background agents after all named agents had completed
• Fixed background sessions started from a non-git directory unable to edit files when a `WorktreeCreate` hook was configured
• Fixed the `@` directory picker in `claude agents` not showing registered git worktrees
• Fixed background task output on Windows being permanently replaced by an empty file after `/clear`
• Fixed content jumping when scrolling up through long transcript history
• Fixed the terminal flickering and jumping while typing in bash mode when a shell-history suggestion was shown
• Fixed literal `^[[I` / `^[[O` escape codes being printed when reattaching to a background session
• Fixed LSP-only plugins being incorrectly flagged for disuse when their language servers deliver diagnostics or answer navigation requests
• Improved responsiveness while long responses stream: live-preview updates no longer re-render the whole screen
• Improved subagent behavior: agents are now less likely to re-delegate their entire task to another subagent
• Reduced binary size by ~7 MB and startup memory by ~7 MB by loading a large bundled dependency lazily instead of inlining it
• Changed left arrow to no longer close the background tasks, diff, and workflow detail views — press Esc instead
• Changed the empty `claude agents` view to always show the organized sections (Needs input / Working / Completed) with descriptions
• Removed the startup "claude command missing or broken" warnings — they now appear in `/doctor` and `/status` instead
• Removed a redundant navigation hint from the `claude agents` footer
• [VSCode] Added a Settings toggle for "Enable Remote Control for all sessions"

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.202
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

+ [config-env] dynamicWorkflowSize: Set dynamic workflow size: small/medium/large agent counts (advisory)
+ [slash-commands] /review <pr>: Fast single-pass PR review
~ [skills-agents] /code-review [effort]: Multi-agent code review with effort; --comment for inline PR comments, --fix to apply findings
- [config-env] autoMode.classifyAllShell

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.199
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

+ [skills-agents] Stacked invocation: Chain up to 5 skills: /skill-a /skill-b do XYZ

- [skills-agents] root SKILL.md
- [config-env] sandbox.allowAppleEvents

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.198
item.description:

+ [skills-agents] /dataviz: Chart and dashboard design guidance; runnable color-palette validator
~ [config-env] Notification: When Claude sends notification; agent_needs_input / agent_completed from bg agents
~ [skills-agents] Explore: Fast read-only (inherits session model, capped at opus)
~ [workflows-tips] isolation: worktree: Agent in own worktree; auto-commits, pushes, opens draft PR
- [slash-commands] /agents

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.196
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

+ [config-env] CLAUDE_ENABLE_STREAM_WATCHDOG: Set 0 to disable; 5-min idle abort+retry on by default for all providers
~ [keyboard-shortcuts] ←: Open agents view
~ [slash-commands] /model [model]: Switch model; Org/Role default when admin sets one (←→ effort, s = session only)
~ [workflows-tips] API key → no cloud: API key / non-Anthropic ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL disables RC, /schedule, MCP, notifications
- [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_RETRIES

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.195
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

+ [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_MOUSE_CLICKS: Disable mouse click/drag/hover in fullscreen mode; wheel scroll still works
- [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_BG_SHELL_PRESSURE_REAP

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.193
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

+ [config-env] autoMode.classifyAllShell: Route all Bash/PowerShell commands through auto-mode classifier
+ [config-env] OTEL_LOG_ASSISTANT_RESPONSES: 1=log assistant responses in OTEL; 0=keep prompts-only; unset follows OTEL_LOG_USER_PROMPTS
+ [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_BG_SHELL_PRESSURE_REAP: Set to 1 to disable automatic memory-pressure reaping of idle bg shells
~ [keyboard-shortcuts] !: Direct bash; file path autocomplete; Claude responds to output
- [config-env] teammateMode: "iterm2"
- [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG
- [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_MCP_TOOL_IDLE_TIMEOUT

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.191
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

~ [slash-commands] /rewind: Rewind conv / code checkpoint; resume from before /clear (/undo alias)

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.187
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

+ [config-env] sandbox.credentials: Block sandboxed commands from reading credential files and secret env vars
+ [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_MCP_TOOL_IDLE_TIMEOUT: Override 5-min idle timeout for remote MCP tool calls
~ [config-env] ANTHROPIC_MODEL: Default model; org restrictions can override
~ [slash-commands] /btw <question>: Side question (no context); ←/→ step through earlier answers
- [config-env] awsAuthRefresh
- [config-env] attribution.sessionUrl

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.186
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

+ [mcp-servers] claude mcp login <name>: Authenticate MCP server from CLI; --no-browser for SSH
+ [mcp-servers] claude mcp logout <name>: Revoke MCP server authentication from CLI
+ [config-env] teammateMode: "iterm2": Use iTerm2 backend for agent teams; warns if it2 CLI missing
+ [config-env] respondToBashCommands: false keeps ! bash output as context only (default: Claude responds)
+ [config-env] awsAuthRefresh: Adds AWS credential refresh option to /login (managed)
+ [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_RETRIES: Max API retries (caps at 15); use RETRY_WATCHDOG for unattended
+ [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG: Alternative retry cap for unattended/headless sessions
~ [keyboard-shortcuts] !: Direct bash; Claude responds to output (respondToBashCommands: false disables)
~ [slash-commands] /workflows: View dynamic workflow runs; press f to filter status
- [config-env] language
- [config-env] enforceAvailableModels
- [config-env] allowManagedHooksOnly
- [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_BUNDLED_SKILLS
- [config-env] CLAUDE_CLIENT_PRESENCE_FILE

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.183
item.description:

- [config-env] footerLinksRegexes

- [config-env] API_FORCE_IDLE_TIMEOUT

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.178
item.description:

+ [skills-agents] Nested .claude/skills: Nested skill dirs load; clashes show as <dir>:<name>
+ [skills-agents] Nested .claude/ priority: Agent/workflow/output-style closest to cwd wins on collision
~ [config-env] deny: tool-name glob: * denies all; Tool(param:value) matches input params; allow rejects non-MCP
~ [config-env] workflowKeywordTrigger: Explicit phrases only ('run a workflow', 'workflow:'); purple shimmer
~ [workflows-tips] Dynamic workflows: Orchestrates tens–hundreds of agents; triggers on 'run a workflow', 'workflow:'
